description: A bitstring dispatch region calls fz_type_of twice (heap binary, shared binary) and boxes its yes/no as an atom the next block decodes with fz_truthy_ref: 3 runtime calls per step, about 8% of the plain walk after inline reads (not isolated). Goal: one kind test, and the region's result is a raw condition. Measure runtime calls per step before and after; re-time the walk. Stacks on fz-sc8.183.5. Evidence and predictions: proposal page fz-sc8.183.5.html (workspace root); spike files in scratchpad b183-5 and b183-6.
title: A bitstring match keeps its type test and result raw
